what: A worker answer cut off at max_tokens, or a ticket that failed twice, was left blocked for a person to write by hand
rule: A cut-off or repeatedly failing ticket must climb to a bigger output, then Codex, then Claude on its own; a person is the last step, not the first.
fix: escalation ladder per ticket (bigger output, hard to Codex, expensive tier to Claude) and ticket sizing at split so one answer fits
